messages:
emma_cs: Heads-up — onboarding for Kestral Labs flagged as a renewal-risk cue after last week's SLO variance. Need a short runbook and credit calc to share at their QBR on Thursday. Who can own the evidence bundle?

raj_support: I can pull the SLO windows and incident timeline. Quick numbers: uptime reported 99.60% for the month (SLO 99.95%), spike on 2026-03-10 02:15 UTC with degraded routing. 95th p50-p95 latency moved to ~420ms (SLO 200ms) during the spike.

jordan_pm: Oof. Customer is expecting a clear comms packet: root cause, duration, mitigations, and proposed credit. They also want steps we've taken to prevent recurrence. Can we draft by EOD Wed?

oliver_sre: @emma_cs I'll attach the incident timeline and postmortem snippet. Short version: a bad autoscale policy + a router fallback misconfiguration. Autoscale had conservative buffer which led to queue build-up. Router fallback triggered a lower-capacity path. Remediations: autoscale policy tweak + router rule change rolled 2026-03-12. No data exfil.

anna_eng: We also landed a partial hotfix to reduce cold start latency for the model shard, landed 2026-03-13. Perf improvement ~30% under load. I'll include the rollout PR and perf bench numbers.

raj_support: For credits, suggest we follow our standard monthly prorated credit calc. Quick calc snippet:
```
credit_pct = min(1.0, (SLO_threshold - observed_uptime) / (SLO_threshold))
credit_amount = monthly_invoice * credit_pct
```
Using numbers: SLO_threshold=99.95, observed=99.60 => delta=0.35/99.95 ~ 0.0035 -> ~0.35% credit. If we include latency breach addendum, could be another 0.25% per policy.

emma_cs: Thanks. Customer will want to see the telemetry evidence (uptime graphs + latency histograms) and our calculation spreadsheet. Raj, can you generate the CSV + calc sheets? Oliver/Anna can you attach PR/incident links?

oliver_sre: attaching links in thread: incident-2026-03-10 (internal PR), autoscale-policy-372, router-fallback-988. Will export metrics window (2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-15).

anna_eng: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR-372, perf bench: gist with 95/99 perc results, hotfix notes included.

ops_bot: Incident Bot: incident-2026-03-10 marked RESOLVED at 2026-03-12T14:07:21Z. Severity: P2. Postmortem status: Draft.

jordan_pm: For the comms: recommend 1) brief summary (1 paragraph), 2) timeline table, 3) customer-facing root cause + mitigations, 4) credit calc appendix (show numbers & formula), 5) next steps + enablement session offer. I'll draft the email and share a Google doc for review by noon Wed.

emma_cs: Perfect. Action owners: Raj -> metrics CSV + credit calc (due Wed 10:00am), Oliver -> incident timeline & links (due Wed 12:00pm), Anna -> perf PR + bench artifacts (due Wed 12:00pm), Jordan -> email draft + doc (due Wed 12:00pm). I'll own the customer QBR comms and run the enablement session.

raj_support: Copy that. Will include raw Prometheus queries and Grafana snapshots. Example queries: `sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count[5m])) by (route)` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))`.

oliver_sre: I'll also produce a short SLO evidence bundle: uptime CSV, per-day window, and affected regions. Noting only us-east-1 saw the router fallback.

anna_eng: I'll prepare a short list of quick wins we can offer the customer (e.g., reserved capacity burst, routing whitelist, model shard pinning) and approximate cost delta.

emma_cs: Great. One more ask from the customer — they want a one-page SLA summary that includes how credits are calculated. Can someone template that? Use the standard SLO wording + a worked example using their invoice numbers.

jordan_pm: I'll add a worked example to the doc. Can you DM me their invoice sample?

emma_cs: Shared invoice sample via secure-share.

raj_support: Uploaded CSV and sheet to the doc.

ops_bot: Deploy Bot: autoscale-policy-372 rolled to prod 2026-03-12T11:02:33Z.

emma_cs: Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate and post the final comms thread here before sending. :thumbsup:
